heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Design
supports: 发送调用返回、写入结果与消费业务完成分属不同边界。
原批次发送结果可能最终失败而日志已追加，调用方不能据超时断言未写入。
生产者幂等的自动retry与应用再次send同eventId分开；本例用新producer重发展示新记录风险。
sources.sections: Message Delivery Semantics; KafkaProducer/ProducerBatch same-commit cross-check

verification.method: Fresh complete HTTPS GETs of official fixed-commit Apache Kafka source through configured proxy; default TLS verification. Canonical kafka.apache.org HTML was not fetched. Relevant original-title and mechanism/API/config paragraphs read directly; not a claim of reading every unrelated section.

quotation.text: If a producer attempts to publish a message and experiences a network error, it cannot be sure if this error happened before or after the message was committed.

sources.title: Producer Configs
supports: acks限定生产者成功确认前提，不替下游业务确认完成。
delivery.timeout.ms约束等待与可重试错误的总期限，独立于一次get(timeout)短等待。
固定幂等要求的acks、retries及max.in.flight约束，避免默认值冲突。
